title: Punch Off
description:
Two [gold]Punch Constructs[/gold] are duking it out and you see some treasure in between them...

Should you try to nab it?

options.title: Nab
options.description: Add [red]Injury[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Obtain a random [gold]Relic[/gold].

notes: This event presents two paths: [gold]Nab[/gold] adds an [red]Injury[/red] curse to your deck and grants a random relic; [gold]I Can Take Them[/gold] leads to combat where defeating the two [gold]Punch Constructs[/gold] awards one relic and one potion as extra rewards beyond the standard encounter loot.
